info.name: GCM Portal
info.description:
GCM Portal API + Platform (Super Admin) collection. Covers everything shipped through Phase 2 so far (Intermediate Facilities, Client Companies) on top of Week 3 (Assets, Vehicles + Driver Management): Tenant Auth, Users, Roles (read-only), Profile, Drivers, Vehicles, Assets & Supply Hub, Intermediate Facilities, Client Companies, and Platform (Tenants/Roles/Permissions CRUD).

See postman/README.md in the repo for how the two auth flows work (Bearer token for /api/v1/*, session+CSRF for /platform/*) and the convention to follow when adding a new endpoint's request here.

Keep this file updated alongside the code: every new API/Platform route gets a request added here in the same PR/session that adds the route.

request.description: Postman is never a SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS origin, so this always returns a bearer `token` (the same path a future mobile app would use) instead of a session cookie. The test script below saves it into {{tenant_token}}, which every other request in this collection sends via the collection-level Bearer auth.
In local dev, MAIL_MAILER=log — grab the reset token from storage/logs/laravel.log.
FRD: the only thing a user changes from their own profile is the photo (multipart, POST + _method=PATCH). Name/email/everything else is admin-managed.
403 for GCM staff and drivers (FRD: an admin sets their password via PATCH /users/{id} or /drivers/{id} with password + password_confirmation). Only client/contractor users (Week 4-5) can use this.
Available to every tenant role (e.g. for a role-assignment dropdown). No mutation route exists here — Role/Permission CRUD lives entirely under Platform (Super Admin), see folder 10-11.

system_admin only (UserPolicy::viewAny). Excludes the caller's own row — self is edited via /me. Genuinely paginated server-side (per_page/page/sort_by/sort_dir all real) — see ARCHITECTURE.md's performance section for why that matters at real employee-count scale.

formdata.description: Exactly one of: data_entry | auditor | driver (system_admin is never creatable here)

request.description: Postman sends real multipart PATCH natively — no _method spoofing needed.
status: active | on_vacation | deactivated. Deactivating a system_admin always fails (422) regardless of who asks — see CannotDeactivateSystemAdminException.
Genuinely paginated server-side, same as /users — see ARCHITECTURE.md's performance section.
Counts (available/on_trips/on_vacation/deactivated) computed against the full tenant-scoped set in SQL — not from whatever page of the list table happens to be loaded.

formdata.description: vehicle_categories.id — see GET /vehicle-categories. At least one required.
vehicles.id — must belong to one of the selected vehicle_category_ids. See GET /vehicles?category=slug.

request.description: Creates the User (role=driver) + Driver profile + any entry permits in one transaction. entry_permits[*] rows are disabled by default — enable them to test that part. vehicle_category_ids/default_vehicle_id need real ids from your DB — check GET /vehicle-categories and GET /vehicles first.

formdata.description: vehicles.id — must belong to one of the selected vehicle_category_ids.

request.description: type: residence | license | operational-license | insurance. Served from the private `local` disk via a policy-gated route — never a static URL.
Replace the `1` with a real entry_permits.id (from Show Driver's entry_permits[].id, or the response of Add Entry Permit).

query.description: vehicle_categories.slug: hook_lift | compactor | dump_truck | water_tanker | dyna_box | tractor_truck
matches plate_letters, plate_numbers, or the combined displayed plate ("ABC 1234", with or without the space)

request.description: system_admin / data_entry / auditor (VehiclePolicy::viewAny). Genuinely paginated server-side, same as /users and /drivers — see ARCHITECTURE.md's performance section.

Counts for the list page cards: by_category (an ARRAY of {id, slug, name, count} — one entry per category the tenant has, zero-count ones included) + availability (available/on_trip/on_maintenance/deactivated), computed in SQL against the full tenant-scoped set. on_trip is always 0 until the Trips module (Week 7).

Plain list of this tenant's vehicle categories (starts as the six defaults; the system_admin can add/rename/delete — see the Vehicle Categories requests below). Readable by EVERY tenant role (form dropdowns). Use the ids/slugs here for vehicle_category_id on Create/Update Vehicle and for a driver's vehicle_category_ids[]. Add ?per_page=10&search=&sort_by=&sort_dir= for the paginated management list (includes vehicles_count/drivers_count/assets_count/in_use).

system_admin ONLY (403 for everyone else). name_en + name_ar required, each unique within the tenant. The slug is generated from name_en once and never changes on rename. Saves last_vehicle_category_id.
system_admin only. Includes vehicles_count / drivers_count / assets_count / in_use.
system_admin only. Names only — the slug is stable.

system_admin only. 204 on success. 422 ("This is a primary category and can't be deleted.") for the six primary categories (the FRD five + Tractor truck) even when unused. 422 with a clear message if a custom category is still used by vehicles, drivers' qualified categories or assets' compatible categories (e.g. "in use by 3 vehicles, 1 asset").
system_admin only. Honours the same `search` (name EN/AR) as the list.
system_admin only. Arabic names render joined/RTL via ArabicText.
Tenant-scoped capacity list for the embedded-container dropdown. Read-only for now — full CRUD lands with the Assets module.

formdata.description: active | on_maintenance | deactivated (deactivated is system_admin only)

request.description: Creates the vehicle + its 4 single documents + any entry permits in one transaction. All *_number fields are digits-only. File fields are disabled by default — enable and pick a file to test uploads.
Includes documents[] — grab a documents[].id for {{last_vehicle_document_id}} to test Download Document.

formdata.description: existing entry_permits.id — keeps its attachment. Blank = new row. Omit a row entirely to delete it.

request.description: Postman sends real multipart PATCH natively — no _method spoofing needed. Everything except operational_status is editable here; status changes go through Change Operational Status.
status: active | on_maintenance | deactivated. Setting or clearing `deactivated` is System Admin only (422 otherwise) — see CannotDeactivateVehicleException.
Set {{last_vehicle_document_id}} from Show Vehicle's documents[].id. Served from the private `local` disk via a policy-gated route; 404 if that document row has no uploaded file.
system_admin / data_entry / auditor (AssetPolicy::viewAny). Genuinely paginated server-side, same as /vehicles.
Containers and tanks counted separately (available / in_projects / on_maintenance / deactivated). in_projects is always 0 until the Projects module (Week 4).

query.description: container | tank — returns capacities that fit that type (applies_to matches, or 'both')
with asset_type — the vehicle form's embedded-container list: only capacities the fleet can field for that vehicle category + kind, derived from the asset pool. Both params required together.
name | applies_to | capacity_cbm | capacity_ton | assets_count | created_at
SEND this to get a paginated {data, meta} response (the management list page does). Omit it entirely — as the form dropdowns do — to get the full unpaginated array.

request.description: Open reference list (any tenant role). Without per_page it returns the full unpaginated array — that's what the vehicle & asset form dropdowns use. With per_page it's genuinely server-side paged/sorted/searched, same as /vehicles (the management list page). With vehicle_category_id + asset_type it returns only the capacities usable as that vehicle category's embedded container (see EmbeddedCapacityFitsVehicleRule).
system_admin / data_entry. `applies_to`: container | tank | both. Both CBM and TON are required.
FRD §1.7.2 — only the name is editable. `applies_to` and the capacities are locked after creation (any other keys sent are ignored). No delete route.

asset_capacity_category_id must fit asset_type (its applies_to is that type or 'both'). compatible_vehicle_category_ids: vehicle_categories.id — at least one required (see Reference — Vehicle Categories in the Vehicles folder). deactivated status is System Admin only. contractor affiliation is rejected until Week 5.

FRD §1.7.3 — the name is the ONLY editable field. Type, capacity, affiliation, purchase date, notes and compatible vehicle categories are all locked (any other keys sent are ignored). operational_status changes via Change Operational Status.
status: active | on_maintenance | deactivated. Setting or clearing `deactivated` is System Admin only (422 otherwise) — see CannotDeactivateAssetException.

FRD V01.14 §1.8. System Admin / Data Entry / Auditor. search matches the name and the 3-letter prefix. environmental_service: disposal | sewage_treatment | recycle. operational_status: active | deactivated. sort_by: name | environmental_service | operational_status | created_at.
Cards on the list page: for each environmental service, how many facilities offer it (`total`) and how many of those are `active`.

formdata.description: Exactly 3 English letters, unique per company (stored upper-case). Change it on every re-run — it is locked after creation.
Required for `recycle` (0–100), rejected for the other services.
pdf / jpg / png, max 4 MB. Private — served only through Download Contract.

request.description: System Admin / Data Entry. Multipart form (the two files are optional — enable them and pick a file). The tenant is taken from the token.
`in_use` is true once a sub-service or trip uses the facility (always false until the Services module exists). `supported_sub_services` is filled by the Services module.

formdata.description: Laravel method spoofing — needed because a multipart body can't be sent with a real PATCH.
Editable only while the facility is unused — 422 once a sub-service or trip uses it.

request.description: System Admin / Data Entry. The name and the optional data are always editable (a new logo / contract attachment replaces the old file). The prefix is never editable (ignored if sent). operational_status changes via Change Operational Status. A JSON PATCH without files works too.
status: active | deactivated. System Admin / Data Entry. No delete route — facilities are deactivated, never removed.
Private file (disk `local`). 404 if the facility has no attachment. System Admin / Data Entry / Auditor.
Same filters and search as the list — the file holds exactly the rows the list shows.

item.name: 9. Client Companies
item.description: Phase 2 · Part 4 — FRD V01.14 §1.11. system_admin / data_entry create, edit and (de)activate; auditor views and exports; driver has no access. No hard delete. Projects, users and contracts counts are 0 until those modules exist.

query.description: matches the name, short name (prefix) or the ID (code)

request.description: system_admin / data_entry / auditor (CompanyPolicy::viewAny). Genuinely paginated server-side.

formdata.description: 3 English letters, unique per tenant, stored upper-case. The company ID is built from it (e.g. ALN-0001), so it cannot be changed after creation.
pdf/jpg/png, max 4MB — private, downloadable only through the download endpoint

request.description: name, prefix and operational_status are required. multipart/form-data. The prefix must be exactly 3 English letters and unique in the tenant — change it if you re-send this request. The response returns the generated company ID (prefix + running number, e.g. ALN-0001).
Returns the company with its contract / commercial-registration / tax-registration blocks (each with a download_url when a file was uploaded) and the placeholder stats.

formdata.description: method spoofing — multipart PATCH is not parsed by PHP
LOCKED after creation — any value sent here is ignored (the company ID ALN-0001 is built from it).
pdf/jpg/png, max 4MB — private, downloadable only through the download endpoint

request.description: Every field is editable (FRD §1.11.4) except the status, which has its own endpoint. Re-send the full form; a file field left out keeps the stored file, a new file replaces it. The short name (prefix) is locked after creation: it is ignored on update and the company ID (prefix + number) never changes.
status: active | deactivated. system_admin / data_entry. Nothing cascades — the FRD does not say a company status affects its projects.
Change the last path segment: contract | cr | tax. Private file — 404 when nothing was uploaded for that type, 403 without view access.
Same filters and search as the list — the file holds exactly the rows the list shows.
Arabic output follows the session locale, like the other exports.

Platform is classic session+CSRF Blade auth (guard `platform`), not Bearer — separate from the tenant API entirely. Run this once to seed {{platform_csrf}} and a session cookie in Postman's cookie jar before Login below.

exec: console.warn('CSRF token not found on /platform/login — check the login blade still has @csrf');

request.description: On success this redirects (302) to /platform/dashboard and sets the platform session cookie, which Postman's cookie jar then attaches to every request in folders 9-11 automatically.
